strings.tutorial.intro.first_level: Welcome to Sugartrail. Swap pieces to clear the board.
strings.tutorial.prompt.select: Tap a piece to select it.
strings.tutorial.prompt.swap: Swipe, or tap a neighbour, to swap.
strings.tutorial.prompt.match: Three of a kind clears them.
strings.tutorial.prompt.cascade: Falling pieces can chain into more matches.
strings.tutorial.prompt.move_limit: You have a limited number of moves.
strings.tutorial.prompt.retry: Lost? Retry any time — every level is unlimited.
strings.tutorial.prompt.pause: Tap the pause button to take a break.
strings.tutorial.prompt.deadlock: If the board deadlocks, a reshuffle keeps you playing.
strings.tutorial.frosting.intro: Frosted cells take an extra clear to break.
strings.tutorial.prompt.frosting.intro: Icy cells cover pieces — match through them to damage the frosting.
strings.tutorial.prompt.frosting.match: Each match on a frosted cell cracks one layer.
strings.tutorial.locked.intro: Some pieces are locked in cages.
strings.tutorial.prompt.locked.intro: Locked pieces won't budge from a regular match.
strings.tutorial.prompt.locked.release: Specials and combos break the lock.
strings.tutorial.layers.intro: Some levels need layers of frosting cleared.
strings.tutorial.prompt.layers.intro: Each frosting match chips a layer — clear them all to win.
strings.tutorial.prompt.layers.break: Every cleared layer counts toward your goal.
strings.tutorial.tokens.intro: Trapped tokens wait for the right piece.
strings.tutorial.prompt.tokens.intro: Match the colour underneath the token to release it.
strings.tutorial.prompt.tokens.release: Released tokens count toward your goal, scoring bonus points.
strings.tutorial.prompt.score.target: Some levels need a score, not a set of pieces.
strings.settings.title: Settings
